rules.name: xoga750-02-masters-and-config
rules.sql: SELECT c.template_name, c.template_type, c.status, c.created_timestamp, c.rule_data #>> '{workflowConfig,buName}' AS config_bu_name, jsonb_pretty(c.rule_data -> 'referenceRegistry') AS reference_registry FROM opera.oga_configservice_uploadrules c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.code = 'PIPELINE CONFIG' AND (c.rule_data::text ILIKE '%gpcTrade%' OR c.rule_data::text ILIKE '%aliasMaster%' OR c.rule_data::text ILIKE '%valuationDate%' OR c.rule_data::text ILIKE '%assignTradeIds%') ORDER BY c.template_name, c.created_timestamp DESC

SELECT d.document_name, d.business_application_name, d.created_timestamp, d.updated_timestamp, d.storage_type, d.object_key, d.size_bytes, length(d.document) AS db_bytes, md5(d.document) AS db_md5, d.mime_type FROM opera.oga_document_repository d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND (lower(d.document_name) LIKE '%currentuser%' OR lower(d.document_name) LIKE '%alias%master%' OR lower(d.document_name) LIKE '%missingdeals%' OR lower(d.document_name) LIKE '%missing deals%' OR lower(d.document_name) LIKE '%gpc%' OR lower(d.document_name) LIKE '%xtrfills%' OR lower(d.document_name) LIKE '%rov%missing%') ORDER BY lower(d.document_name), d.created_timestamp DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (lower(d.document_name)) d.document_name, d.business_application_name, d.created_timestamp, d.storage_type, d.object_key, length(d.document) AS db_bytes, md5(d.document) AS db_md5, CASE WHEN length(d.document) <= :maxDocBytes THEN replace(encode(d.document, 'base64'), chr(10), '') END AS content_base64 FROM opera.oga_document_repository d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND (lower(d.document_name) LIKE '%currentuser%' OR lower(d.document_name) LIKE '%missingdeals%' OR lower(d.document_name) LIKE '%missing deals%' OR lower(d.document_name) LIKE '%gpc%' OR lower(d.document_name) LIKE '%xtrfills%') ORDER BY lower(d.document_name), d.created_timestamp DESC
